Bind Plot Data Tables

Source: R/figure-data.R
PlotDataBindRows.Rd

PlotDataBindRows() stacks tables by column name, filling columns missing from some tables with NA. It can record the source of each row (names_to, after the table columns) and add constant key columns per table (keys, before the table columns). PlotDataBindColumns() places one-row (or equally long) tables side by side.

Usage

PlotDataBindRows(
  tables,
  names_to = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  keys = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  rename = NULL,
  element = NULL
)

PlotDataBindColumns(tables)

Arguments

tables

A list of data frames (named when names_to without labels, keys or rename are used), or a single data frame.

names_to

Optional column recording the source of each row: the list name, the matching entry of labels, or the list position.

labels

Optional source labels, one per table.

keys

Optional named list: table name to a named list of scalar values added as leading columns. For a single data frame, keys is the named list of values itself.

columns

Optional columns kept from every table.

rename

Optional named list of renamings per table: table name to a named vector (new name = old name).

element

Optional element name when the list items are lists that hold the tables.

Value

A data frame.

See also

Other plot-data builders: PlotDataConstant(), PlotDataCount(), PlotDataCrossShares(), PlotDataDirection(), PlotDataDominant(), PlotDataFromArrays(), PlotDataJoin(), PlotDataKeyColours(), PlotDataLabels(), PlotDataLonger(), PlotDataMembership(), PlotDataPairRatio(), PlotDataProduct(), PlotDataQuantiles(), PlotDataRankRows(), PlotDataRatio(), PlotDataRecode(), PlotDataRelative(), PlotDataSelect(), PlotDataShares(), PlotDataSummarise(), PlotDataUnite()

Examples

PlotDataBindRows(list(a = data.frame(x = 1), b = data.frame(x = 2, y = 3)), names_to = "src")
#>   x src  y
#> 1 1   a NA
#> 2 2   b  3
PlotDataBindRows(list(a = data.frame(v = 1), b = data.frame(v = 2:3)),
                 keys = list(a = list(batch = "one"), b = list(batch = "two")))
#>   batch v
#> 1   one 1
#> 2   two 2
#> 3   two 3
PlotDataBindColumns(list(data.frame(n = 9), data.frame(text = "p1, 1")))
#>   n  text
#> 1 9 p1, 1
